# Unpaused

> Unpaused (https://unpaused.online) is a free browser game site that aims to be one of the best places to play free browser games: hand-picked, high-quality games, a clean design and a smooth system. It has 10 games: three originals, Aurora, Worldloom and TacticStrike, plus the open-source browser classics HexGL, 2048, Hextris, A Dark Room, Coastline Racer, Blockfall and Clumsy Bird, credited to their creators. Every game is free, with no ads and no account needed. Games open from the home page and play in the browser without installing a game launcher.

Who it is for: players who want free games they can open straight in a desktop web browser, with keyboard and mouse (Aurora also has full controller support). Worldloom needs WebGL 2 and hardware acceleration.

Key facts:
- Aurora, Worldloom and TacticStrike are free to play in the browser. TacticStrike also has an optional credit shop.
- No game download or launcher is required.
- An optional account holds your username, friend code, Worldloom invites and up to ten saved worlds. You can sign in with Google or verify your email.
- Worldloom supports two players per account world: the owner and one invited friend.

## Original games

- [Aurora](https://unpaused.online/aurora/): A 3D space maze, only on Unpaused. Guide a small astronaut across floating crystal islands and, in Chapter 2, a living jungle island. Collect three star shards to wake the portal, dodge lasers, drones and insects, and hunt for hidden relics. Guide: https://unpaused.online/games/aurora/
- [Worldloom](https://unpaused.online/worldloom/): A voxel survival and building game. Gather resources, craft tools, and explore forests, oceans and underground caves. Choose Wayfarer for survival or Dreamweaver to build freely and fly. Guide: https://unpaused.online/games/worldloom/
- [TacticStrike](https://unpaused.online/tacticstrike/): A top-down tactical shooter. Online matches and lobbies (1v1 and 2v2), plus training bots to practise against. Guide: https://unpaused.online/games/tacticstrike/

## More to play

- [HexGL](https://unpaused.online/hexgl/): Futuristic 3D anti-gravity racing.
- [2048](https://unpaused.online/2048/): The sliding number puzzle.
- [Hextris](https://unpaused.online/hextris/): Rotate the hexagon to match falling colored blocks.
- [A Dark Room](https://unpaused.online/adarkroom/): A minimalist text adventure by Doublespeak Games (MPL-2.0).
- [Coastline Racer](https://unpaused.online/racer/): A retro pseudo-3D arcade racer by Jake Gordon (MIT).
- [Blockfall](https://unpaused.online/blockfall/): A falling block puzzle, based on Jake Gordon's open-source JavaScript game (MIT).
- [Clumsy Bird](https://unpaused.online/clumsy-bird/): A one-button flying arcade game by Ellison Leão (GPL-3.0).

## Other

- [Onyx](https://unpaused.online/Onyx/): A free desktop app for Claude Code, ChatGPT (Codex) and OpenCode, for Windows, macOS and Linux.
